notes: Accept, after corrections made in place. The text read is the version of record, Annals of Mathematics 191 (2020), 635–674, freely available from the journal (SHA-256 8b76bfac…4b60, matching the record); no arXiv version exists, and sourceVersions now records the reading, so collation.py classifies the paper as read in its published form. All five recorded misprints are confirmed on the page images. Seven mistakes are added (E6–E12): a gap in the §3.3 sketch for the families j = n + in0, where the bound 2d³ + 1 ignores that every m with ψ(m) ≤ d must be avoided at once (E10); Lemma 5.5's conclusion, which must be ord(ϕ) > W for its use (E11); the display defining D(A), which repeats E1 and gives determinant 0 instead of 4 for Z[i] (E9); the §1.3 citations [25], [26] for [26], [27] (E6); a sign in the matrix after (42) (E7); the sum Σψ(m) ≤ Σd in §3.1 (E8); and a word slip on p. 635 (E12). None affects a stated result. Routes 2 and 3 placed items upstream of what they need and are corrected in place; all eight routes are accepted, one of them (route 8) new. Four items are added (69–72), and thirty-two existing items are corrected, among them items 21 and 65, which change status. The result has 72 items (56 missing, 13 planned, 3 library). For the orchestrator: links needed, none closing a cycle: PELModuli:M5, ShimuraData:D5 and ModularCurvesPartII:R12.1 → LD.6; SieveMethodsAndPrimePatterns:SV.2 → IG.2; ModularCurvesPartII:R13.4 → ComplexMultiplicationAndExplicitReciprocity:CM.3. Weakly special subvarieties are claimed both by LD.6 (TSIMERMAN-18) and by MOK-PILA-TSIMERMAN-19's Part II; one owner should be chosen.
